page.overview:
Who is Armed Samurai - Ben Kei?

Armed Samurai - Ben Kei, known as Heavy Armored Warrior - Ben Kei in the Japanese version, is a character version of the card, "Armed Samurai - Ben Kei". He appears in the video games, Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2008 and Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2009: Stardust Accelerator.

In Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2008, he appear as a Tag Duel opponent and his Tag partner is Mataza the Zapper. Their team name is Invasion of Flames.

In Stardust Accelerator, he appears as a single Duel opponent and a Tag Duel opponent. His Tag partner is Maha Vailo and their name is Get a Weapon!.

Armed Samurai - Ben Kei uses an Equip Spell Card Warrior Deck titled, "Unrivaled Benkei", who is based on his summon and the use of his special hability.
